svg.title: Accuracy against model call time for each configuration of each AI step
svg.desc: Five scatter panels, one per AI step. Each dot is one configuration. Across: median model call time in seconds on a log scale. Up: tuning cases passed. Every value is also in evals/sweep/results.csv.
svg.text: Accuracy against response time: one dot per configuration
Each AI step measured on its own tuning cases, one run per case. Up: cases passed. Across: median time for one model call.
Local Ollama models, 2026-11-24, Ollama 0.40.5, power mode: high power. Dots that would coincide are nudged apart. Hover a dot for its settings; every value is in results.csv.
